title: Separate prepared-Begin fixture barrier wait from measured collection cost
outcome: The fixture observer does not attribute the prepared-Begin barrier handshake to collector work.
acceptance: Keep the existing collect-phase observation needed by the deterministic barrier control, but start measured collection after the barrier or expose the barrier wait explicitly as a separate bounded duration.
A phase control discriminates the barrier wait from completed collection timing without changing durable-content acknowledgement, real-clock fence deadlines or production persistence behavior.
Retain the original run and reviewer evidence; disclose the original sample's induced handshake inclusion and do not infer historical queued-deadline or grant-expiry causation.
